title: Cosmic Sea Spirit
description: A surreal painting features a glowing, ethereal female spirit with closed eyes and flowing multicolored hair at the center of a circular purple portal. The spirit emerges from a dark sea with icebergs and a small sailboat, surrounded by floating orbs containing faces, red poinsettia flowers, stars, a crescent moon, and a distant castle on a mountain.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of an ethereal female spirit with closed eyes and long flowing hair in shades of blue, green and yellow, emerging from a glowing purple circular portal with radiating light beams. She is surrounded by smaller floating orbs containing stylized faces, set against a dark cosmic night sea with icebergs, a small sailboat, a distant castle on a mountain, red poinsettia flowers blooming on the sides, stars and a crescent moon in the sky.
